_header: REGRESSION LOCK, NOT A CORRECTNESS PROOF. Captured on this machine by the implementation that replays it, so it says only that today's build answers what the build that captured it answered. It cannot say either answer is right. No independent implementation of this vision tower exists in this tree to capture a reference from. See test-vectors/README.md.

_fixture: an 8-frame 128x128 GIF at 2 fps of a white bar sweeping left to right, generated by the test rather than committed, plus the prompt 'Describe what happens in this clip in one short sentence.' The clip's 8 frames fold into 4 temporal groups, which is the multi-group path a still image never reaches.
_what_this_does_not_prove: that the frames reached the model. That is the paired request in the same test: a second clip of identical frame count and size and different pixels must produce a different answer, which it cannot on a build that drops the pixels.
answer: A white line moves from left to right across a black background.
